item.title: Megadev: A Development Kit for the Sega Mega Drive and Mega CD Hardware
item.description:

item.title: How Lego builds a new Lego set
item.description:
📝 And this time, Lego finally got in touch. The Lego Ideas Polaroid OneStep in final prototype form, with its film bay open, sitting alongside its brick-built film box and photocards. Here’s a GIF we made that flips back and forth between the Lego Polaroid and the one that takes film.

item.title: RAM kits are now sold with one fake RAM stick alongside a real one
item.description:
📝 While they light up and synchronize with your existing RGB ecosystem, they don't contribute to your computer’s memory capacity or performance. Despite the growing importance of aesthetics in PC building, few memory vendors have fully embraced the concept of dummy or filler memory modules. However, with memory prices currently inflated, it’s easy to see the appeal of cost-effective options like V-Color’s 1+1 memory kits.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/ram/fake-ram-bundled-with-real-ram-to-create-a-performance-illusion-for-amd-users-1-1-value-pack-offers-desperate-psychological-relief-as-the-memory-shortage-worsens
